sources.title: 計画の進捗報告（第2次札幌市まちづくり戦略ビジョン・アクションプラン2023）
sources.review_boundary: Phase 13 reviewed aggregate source-reported facts from the 2025 report: 17 of 26 outcome indicators above the planning baseline, 394 of 403 principal project targets expected to be achieved, and a mixed settlement-plus-budget cumulative project amount of 998.3 billion yen. These values are not independent Jichi Insight achievement judgments.

quality_boundary: This inventory confirms official entry points and high-level periods. Phase 13 has promoted selected fiscal and implementation-plan aggregate facts to Reviewed in separate review packages, while individual policy targets, projects, survey values, fiscal links, cross-city comparability, causal claims, and policy-achievement judgments remain outside this inventory state.
next_action: Review the second strategic vision policy targets and the Action Plan 2023 individual 599-project catalog at page-level evidence depth, then expand the 2025 progress report from aggregate facts to its 26 individual outcome indicators and 403 principal project targets.
